light.$description: The light engine (data-light, applyLight in appearance.ts): how light falls on the stone. Edge, the look without a setting, draws a light top edge on every raised surface and on the lit controls. Glow also lets the one accent fill, an on switch and a running bar catch light from above, and stone, the hidden level, is glow with a grain over the page. Off leaves the plain shadows. Declared wherever a theme is set, so each light-dark() lands on that theme.

modes.name: off
modes.$description: Off: the shadows without the edge, and the controls flat.

modes.name: glow
modes.$description: Glow and stone: the accent fill, an on switch and a running bar catch the light.

light-edge.$description: The light top edge of a raised surface.

elevation-raised.$value: {light.light-edge}, 0 0 0 1px light-dark(rgb(0 0 0 / 0.045), rgb(0 0 0 / 0.35)), 0 1px 2px light-dark(rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05), rgb(0 0 0 / 0.4)), 0 6px 20px -8px light-dark(rgb(0 0 0 / 0.12), rgb(0 0 0 / 0.7))
elevation-raised.$description: The raised step: the edge, a faint contact line that keeps a white card off a white page, and a short shadow under it. The shadow is neutral black, since a tinted one under the stone reads as a colour cast.

elevation-control.$description: A lit control: the quiet button and the chosen segment take the edge and a short shadow of their own.

light-sheen.$description: The accent button's light from above.

light-sheen-on.$description: An on switch's light from above.

elevation-accent.$description: The accent button's edge: a top light and an inner line a shade under the fill.

light-progress.$description: The light a running bar sheds on its track.
